  **Value:** 268.96886765240527 · **Unit:** `mA`

  **Conditions:** C11's share of the 0.807 A rms output ripple on '/DC-DC Conversion/-13.5V OUT' in the three-can bank C11 || C24 || C12 at the 0.8 A rated load, ripple dividing as 1/ESR at the LM2596's 150 kHz.   **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH · **Provenance:** CALCULATED

  **Evidence:** [`src-c696190-primary`](#src-c696190-primary) — calculated from fact-c696190-esr-120hz and fact-c22387780-esr-120hz against the Vsat-inclusive 0.807 A output-cap ripple (spec-architecture-review.md section BB-7); bank membership per board\_b\_spec.py NETS row '/DC-DC Conversion/-13.5V OUT'

## Calculation dependencies

These values were derived from other recorded facts rather than read from a document. The expression and every input are published so the number can be recomputed instead of trusted. A derived value is never stronger than the weakest fact it depends on.

**Fact:** [`fact-c696190-esr-120hz`](#fact-c696190-esr-120hz)

**Expression:** `fact_c696190_tan_delta / (2 * 3.141592653589793 * 120 * fact_c696190_capacitance * 0.000001)`

**Depends on:**

- [`fact-c696190-tan-delta`](#fact-c696190-tan-delta)
- [`fact-c696190-capacitance`](#fact-c696190-capacitance)

**Fact:** [`fact-c696190-ripple-hf-derate`](#fact-c696190-ripple-hf-derate)

**Expression:** `fact_c696190_ripple_120hz * fact_c696190_ripple_freq_multiplier`

**Depends on:**

- [`fact-c696190-ripple-120hz`](#fact-c696190-ripple-120hz)
- [`fact-c696190-ripple-freq-multiplier`](#fact-c696190-ripple-freq-multiplier)

**Fact:** [`fact-c696190-c11-ripple-share-3can`](#fact-c696190-c11-ripple-share-3can)

**Expression:** `0.8 * ((13.53 + 0.55) / (15 - 1.16 + 13.53 + 0.55) / (1 - (13.53 + 0.55) / (15 - 1.16 + 13.53 + 0.55))) ** 0.5 * 1000 * (1 / fact_c696190_esr_120hz) / (1 / fact_c696190_esr_120hz + 2 / fact_c22387780_esr_120hz)`

**Depends on:**

- [`fact-c696190-esr-120hz`](#fact-c696190-esr-120hz)
- [`fact-c22387780-esr-120hz`](/docs/components/records/c22387780/#fact-c22387780-esr-120hz) on EFVH035ADA471M10B0
